title: 'Crawfish Blues' royalties of 49 cents and the unfinished Pelican Trio record
summary: His blues with Zutty, called 'Crawfish Blues', earned him 49 cents after sixteen years from Mickey Goldsen, and the last Pelican Trio session got hung up and is unfinished.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

blocks.x: When I recorded with Zutty and made a blues, he called it the 'Crawfish Blues.' He called it the 'Crawfish Blues.' So I get a big royalty on that -- 75 cents every three months, --
-- it's from Mickey Goldsen. I said, 'Mickey, when you're going to send me a nice big fat check for the 'Crawfish Blues?' And he starts laughing. 49 cents after 16 years. But that's all right.
But that's a lot of fun, though, you know.
The last recording of the Pelican Trio, we didn't
know what -- it got hung up. I mean, it was so long and drawn out, you know. But that was it. So we never finished it. So we're going to try to finish it pretty soon, I hope.
